measurement: Serialized synthetic Responses-shaped request UTF-8 bytes, not tokens or captured HTTP traffic.
fixture_construction: One fixed user placeholder replaces all original user text.
Known reasoning items use synthetic opaque placeholders, not original encrypted reasoning.
Saved tool names, arguments and text content are retained; non-tool assistant prose omitted.
Absent tool text uses an explicit placeholder because original error wire encoding was not captured.
Twelve full histories and 140 tool-bearing assistant-boundary prefixes are separate datasets; prefixes overlap.

strict_source_check.method: Read-only fixed index plus physical source hash; BOM preserved in UTF-16 raw-span coordinates; exact rendered text, line, workspace, snapshot, project, variant and role.
strict_source_check.verifier_correction: An earlier independent verifier stripped UTF-8 BOM and undercounted eligible ranges. Corrected to the product BOM-preserving coordinate contract; transformer metrics unchanged. Final formatted core was replayed again with identical totals.

limitations: No model, API or network calls; no actual HTTP request reconstruction.
No measured token, cost, latency or answer-quality benefit.
Full-history ratios use the exact placeholder-based synthetic JSON denominator.
Prefix totals are overlapping projections, not actual cumulative model input savings.
All twelve source configurations disable automatic compaction and no compaction events were observed; persisted exports do not prove residency in each sent request.
Core reports parsed versus opaque target counts, not detailed skip reasons; zero-change sessions remain valid no-ops.
Transformer performs guarded literal factoring, not source-identity or semantic equivalence proof; strict source checks are independent offline evidence.
Historical frozen experimental outputs and scripts are unchanged; no raw fixtures are intended for repository publication.
reproduction_outline: Obtain the authorized nonpublic frozen B/C exports and transport logs.
Construct fixed-placeholder Responses requests and tool-bearing assistant-boundary prefixes as described.
Import the exact hashed transformer; deep-freeze inputs; apply explicit enabled/openai/responses/evidence_explore options.
Check restore equality, no mutation, unchanged non-target items and fields, and non-increasing serialized JSON bytes.
Count changed target-body anchors/references and join their original body hashes to independently verified index/raw-span evidence.
Retain only this sanitized aggregate in the repository; retain source-bearing fixtures privately.
